preconditions.description: The input size n must be between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the array must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.
The array a must have exactly n elements.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each position in the array.

postconditions.expression: all(d_i == -1 or d_i >= 1 for d_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value d_i must be either -1 (impossible) or a positive integer (minimum moves).

postconditions.expression: all((a_i % 2 == 0 and any(a_j % 2 == 1 for j in range(1, n+1) if d_j != -1)) or (a_i % 2 == 1 and any(a_j % 2 == 0 for j in range(1, n+1) if d_j != -1)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each position i, if d_i is not -1, there must exist at least one position j with opposite parity of a_i reachable in d_i moves.

postconditions.expression: all((d_i == -1 or (d_i == min(moves for moves in reachable_moves if moves >= 1))) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For each position i, d_i must be the minimum number of moves to reach any position j with opposite parity of a_i, or -1 if no such position exists.
